about: Danielle Crane is an attorney who represents clients in the Columbus, Ohio area. Danielle Crane is recognized by peers and was selected to Rising Stars for 2024 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Danielle Crane chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. She attended Capital University Law School and graduated in 2019. Danielle Crane passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2019.
She represents clients with Employment & Labor: Employer issues in Ohio. She also represents clients with Workers' Compensation: Employer / Insurance issues.

Being selected to Rising Stars is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Rising Stars, Danielle Crane has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
